Here is what I found on the internet so far for saddles:

Leather

Leather (honey leather) saddle: http://www.ebay.com/itm/CLASSIC-HONEY-LEATHER-COPPER-VINTAGE-STYLE-BIKE-SADDLE-SEAT-FREE-USA-SHIPPING-/351462288477?pt=LH_DefaultDomain_0&hash=item51d4c8ec5d

Sprung leather (honey leather) saddle: http://www.ebay.com/itm/Vintage-Style-Hairpin-Bicycle-Saddle-HONEY-TAN-Leather-Bike-Seat-SHIPS-FREE-USA-/381335743770?pt=LH_DefaultDomain_0&hash=item58c961ad1a

I can't speak for either of these- anyone wanna buy one and review? Still, they're the cheapest leather seats I ever found.

Other:

"Breatheable" saddle (read: it's just plastic in the shape of a saddle. I wouldn't ride it, but this is 'budget biking.') and it's a few bucks.

http://www.ebay.com/itm/Breathable-MTB-Mountain-Road-Bicycle-Cycling-Bike-Hollow-Web-Saddle-Seat-Plastic-/361351760470?var=&hash=item54223e4a56

This is a $7.50 bike seat. I've ridden on one of these before- it was a little uncomfortable, but it wasn't the worst saddle ever made, nor was it the least stylish by a long shot.

http://www.ebay.com/itm/New-Road-Mountain-MTB-Gel-Comfort-Saddle-Bike-Bicycle-Cycling-Seat-Cushion-Pad-/361290038976?pt=LH_DefaultDomain_0&hash=item541e907ec0

http://www.ebay.com/itm/MTB-Cycling-Road-Bike-Bicycle-Replacement-Saddle-Soft-PU-Leather-Seat-Pad-01-/190714675568?hash=item2c677b0170

For this one, the padding was pretty sparse, and I found it worked way better on my twelve speed, though out of desperation I once mounted it on a customer's MTB when I found the old saddle had failed (split where the rail meets the saddle) and I didn't have any better ones available. It looked nice, and he's said he finds it comfortable, so...your mileage may vary?

http://www.ebay.com/itm/V1NF-Riveted-Leather-Fixed-Gear-Bike-Track-Bicycle-Cycling-Saddle-Seat-Fixie-/221536288389?var=&hash=item3394977e85

Stylish, but not the most comfortable thing ever made. Still, when a customer wants a fixed geared bike that has matching tape or grips matched to rims/tires or seat, this is generally the kind of seat style they have in mind, because they've seen it around. These are the cheapest ones I've found available online.

http://www.niagaracycle.com/categories/sunlite-bicycle-saddle-quilted-racing-black

These do the job pretty well. If you have a J&B Catalogue access, they're like $3-$4 each, and for that reason they're my go-to for ordering. They work on just about anything you put someone on- I've found they're best for hybrids and ten speeds. The stitching is a nice touch.

http://www.jensonusa.com/Bicycle-Saddles/Blackburn-Ciento-Classic-Road-Saddle

Shipping costs are not included on this, and I think they vary a bit, but blackburn's a quality name.

I'm thrilled that my town has a bike shop with a "Saddle Library". Pay a $20 fee, check out saddles to ride for a few days. If you finally find one you like, the $20 can be applied to the purchase of the saddle. Such a great service!
Oh, that's a neat idea! I love the idea!
